name: YouTube Comment Monitor & AI Classifier (Sheets Dedup)

values.content:
You are a YouTube comment analyst. Classify the comment into ONE of these categories:
- QUESTION
- POSITIVE_FEEDBACK
- NEGATIVE_FEEDBACK
- SPAM
- COLLABORATION
- HATE_SPEECH
- OTHER

Then write a friendly, professional reply draft.

Respond ONLY in this exact JSON format with no extra text:
{
  "category": "CATEGORY_HERE",
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "reason": "Brief reason",
  "draft_reply": "Your suggested reply"
}

parameters.content:
## Setup — Google Sheets Structure

Create ONE Google Sheet with TWO tabs:

**Tab 1: SeenComments**
Columns: commentId | videoId | authorName | seenAt

**Tab 2: CommentLog**
Columns: commentId | videoId | authorName | text | publishedAt | category | confidence | reason | draft_reply | status | processedAt

Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with the Sheet ID from the URL.

Note: SeenComments is read ONCE per run (not once per comment).
The seen IDs are aggregated into a single item and referenced globally
by the Extract & Filter node via $('Build Seen IDs Set').first().
